'''Ikito Elfwannabe''' was one of the surviving members of the [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]].

==Biography==
Around [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], Ikito Elfwannabe terrorized the spacelanes in the ''[[Red Sin Chimaera]]''. For this reason, [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] were told to apprehend him on sight.<ref name="Sony">{{SonyCite|url=en_US/players/content.vm?id=66851&resource=features|text=Star Chart: Endor System}}</ref>
